Name: Vanilla Assets As Furniture
Author: sexynes
Description:
This mod adds over 500 vanilla assets as furniture. The dedicated catalogues can be purchased at Robin's Carpenter Shop. However, to access the dedicated catalogues, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties - MMAP[/url] must be installed. Otherwise, the furniture can be accessed from the standard furniture catalogue. 

I have not tested all the assets, so if there are any issues, report them and I can try updating. Also, although it may not be possible to mod particular furnitures, if there is one you think I missed and would like it to be added, feel free to report it.
